_note: Hand-checked service time for a later publish guard. Each total is counted from MLB Stats API transaction dates and the championship-season calendar, under the 2022-26 agreement: 172 credited days is a year, a season cannot credit more than that, and 2020 is scaled up to a full year when the player was on the roster the whole shortened season. Days on the active roster or a major-league injured list count, including bereavement and paternity. Optional-assignment days count only when they total fewer than 20 in that season, and that same total of 20 or more uses an option year. The option date counts and the recall date does not. A spring option starts on Opening Day, which is that league-wide first game even when the player's own club opens a day or two later. The restricted list does not count, except Trevor Bauer's paid administrative leave. A tiebreaker game extends the season only for the clubs that played it. Opening Day is the first regular-season game within 187 days of the season's end, and a club that opened overseas earlier keeps that earlier date. An All-Star assignment, a winter-league assignment, and a minor-league all-star assignment are not demotions. Nothing here is copied from a salary site. The counts are from public transaction dates and the season calendar. Transaction rows used for the count are in tests/golden/transactions/.
